min.description: the minimum value of the input stream, for string will return string of minimum length

max.description: the maximum value of the input stream, for string will return string of maximum length

invalidCount.description: number of elements that did not match the specified ValueType of this Digest

spec.description: Stores the spec for what statistics were calculated for this Digest

hyperLogLog.description: Stores input data in a HyperLogLog structure used for estimating unique count

countMinSketch.description: Stores input data in a CountMinSketch structure used for estimating frequent elements

minHash.description: Stores hashes of a subset of input data used for approximate inclusion tests

fieldStats.description: Statistics of field values in arbitrary dataset.

title:
Type for collecting digests from files columns and presenting them,
Additionally computes aggregate stats
Example:
 fileDigest = ObjDigest.fromFile(f)
 c3Viz(fileDigest) // click on fieldStats to see all fields, click again on a field to get stats for that field
 fileDigest.nullPercent() //returns percentage of null entries passed into fileDigest
 fileDigest.fieldStats().get("numericField").approxHistogram() //returns histogram object for "numericField"
 fileDigest.fieldStats().get("stringField").approxUniqueCount() //returns approx unique count of "stringField"
 fileDigest.fieldStats().get("stringField").approxMostFrequentElements()
 //returns approx most frequent elements and approx their frequency of field "stringField"
See {@link Digest}, {@link StringDigest}, {@link NumericDigest}, {@link BooleanDigest} for more documentation
on interpreting field level stats.
name: ObjDigest
